title: Λέξεις Πλατωνικαί / Lexicon Platonicum / «Платоновский лексикон»
author: Timaeus the Sophist
edition: Ruhnken 1754/1789; Koch 1828 (PD). M. Bonelli 2007 (Brill; in copyright).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Тимей (греческий грамматик)) lists no translation. None found.
en_evidence: en.wikipedia lists only Bonelli's French. No English found.
other_translations: French: M. Bonelli, Timée le Sophiste. Lexique platonicien (Brill 2007).
value: Ancient Platonic philology and Attic usage; the reception of Plato in the Imperial period. A natural fit for the Russian Platonic studies community. Small enough to finish quickly.
ai_feasibility: high: brief glosses; Bonelli's French is available for cross-checking.
